name: Kingsmen Oracle Free Bootstrap Plan
purpose: Prepare Kingsmen for Oracle Cloud Free Tier / Oracle Lite deployment while protecting candidate safety, repo proof discipline, OpenClaw boundaries, and free-tier resource limits.

officialSourceNotes.capacityWarning: Free resources depend on account, region, signup, service, and live capacity. Kingsmen must not assume capacity until the founder account and region confirm it.

deploymentIntent.defaultRegionPolicy: Founder chooses the nearest available OCI commercial region during signup; adjacent region is acceptable when first choice is unavailable.
deploymentIntent.targetUse: single-founder low-concurrency Kingsmen build, validation, demo, and first Oracle Lite runtime proof
notYetAllowed: paid resource creation without founder approval

discipline: Airtable mirror interval fifteen minutes or longer

openClawPlacement.default: same repo, local or development helper only until Oracle capacity is proven
openClawPlacement.oracleOption: separate small worker VM or paused local helper when capacity permits
openClawPlacement.hardRule: If OpenClaw competes with Kingsmen core resources, pause OpenClaw first. Candidate runtime wins.

storage.blockVolume: local Docker volumes for PostgreSQL, Redis, logs, and reports during bootstrap
storage.objectStorage: future evidence or document backup only after signed upload and privacy validation
storage.documentRule: No real candidate documents until N05 and N03 storage, RLS, signed upload, and audit gates pass.

network.databaseExposure: PostgreSQL and Redis must not be publicly exposed

bootstrapSteps.name: Create or confirm OCI Free account
bootstrapSteps.proof: OCI tenancy created or confirmed, region selected, and signup completed only through Oracle official flow.

bootstrapSteps.name: Create compartment and network shell
bootstrapSteps.proof: Compartment, VCN, subnet, ingress rules, and admin fingerprint recorded in masked report.

bootstrapSteps.name: Create Oracle Lite VM
bootstrapSteps.proof: VM created with chosen free-eligible shape where available; public IP and OS recorded without sensitive values.

bootstrapSteps.name: Install base runtime
bootstrapSteps.proof: Docker, Docker Compose, Git, Node, Nginx, log pruning, and firewall status report generated.

bootstrapSteps.name: Clone repo and run validators
bootstrapSteps.proof: N09, Creator, provider health, OpenClaw, and Oracle bootstrap validators pass with productionReady=false.

bootstrapSteps.name: Run Docker Compose boot proof
bootstrapSteps.owner: Future N01 and N02 runtime validators
bootstrapSteps.proof: Backend, web, PostgreSQL, Redis, and health endpoints pass local Oracle Lite report.

canHelp: monitor local CPU RAM disk after permission
